The main takeaway from our work is that
a distributed production system can be easily set up and managed by a relatively small team.

the distributed production model, with the proposed set of tools, can be successfully applied to a large scale experiment like SuperB, and that the distributed computing infrastructure can be exploited in a very efficient way.
